sections.content: You know every structure here: comparison (A2 Unit 6), *creo que* (B1 Unit 13), *es importante que* + subjunctive (A2 Unit 27) and *aunque* (A2 Unit 28). Combine them to discuss language, culture and identity.

items.spanish: Creo que las diferencias culturales pueden ser una oportunidad para aprender.
items.english: I think cultural differences can be an opportunity to learn.

items.spanish: Es importante que escuchemos otras perspectivas.
items.english: It is important that we listen to other perspectives.

items.spanish: Aunque nuestras costumbres son diferentes, creo que escuchar es tan importante como comparar.
items.english: Although our customs are different, I think listening is as important as comparing.

sections.content: A longer answer uses more than one structure: in the third example, *aunque* opens a concession and *tan importante como* gives the comparison.
